lang.description: Publication language: de, fr, it or en.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 100; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

pub_types.description: Publication types to keep; the date matched is each project's newest publication.

since.description: Start of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 7 days ago.

until.description: End of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
